Megha Goel  Versus  The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Pratyush Patwari ..for the Petitioner  Mr. Suddhadev Adak  Ms. Richa Pramanik ...for the State

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner is taken  on record.
None appears for the private respondents despite service.

The petitioner alleges that though pursuant to her complaint, a case has been registered under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code against the private respondents, no step has been taken by the Investigating Officer for recovery of her stridhan articles and recording her statement as well as statement of other witnesses under Section 183 of the BNSS.
Learned counsel for the State seeks accommodation to submit a report on the adjourned date in this regard.
Let this matter appear under the same heading on January 22, 2026.
(Suvra Ghosh,J)
